                                            Ordinance


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-H in the area bounded by:


A line 145.45 feet north of and parallel to West Oakdale Avenue; North Leavitt Street; a line
70.45 feet north of and parallel to West Oakdale Avenue; and the alley next west of and parallel
to North Leavitt Street.


to those of a C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.


SECTION 2. This Ordinance be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Common Address of Property:          2940-46 N. Leavitt Street
                         PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                             (TYPE 1 REZONING)

Re:    2940-46 N. Leavitt Street

The Applicant seeks a change in zoning from Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing / Business Park
District to C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District, to allow for outdoor activities for an
existing dog day care and boarding/kennel services business.
